# Ender's Delight 1.1.4

Fixed an issue where placing a block on top of an Endstone Stove would chunkban the player. [[#37]](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/37)

Fixed an issue where End House would spawn in the void. [[#40]](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/40)

Updated the mod to run on forge 47.4.10

changelog:
# Ender's Delight 1.20.1 Rework
## Our biggest rework yet !

## ADDED:

 - 4 New Ender vegetables
 - 5 New foods
 - A new structure
 - JEI Info for the droppable items
 - A new crafting item

## FIXED:

 - Tooltip not showing for Mite Crust, Enderman Sight, and Shulker Mollusk
 - Endstone Stove not emitting light
 - #9 [Chorus Juice stacks up to 64 pieces.](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/9)
 - #12 [[Suggestion] Please replace the descriptions of mite crust, enderman sight, and shulker with JEI descriptions.](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/12)
 - #22 [[1.20.1] Chorus Juice does not appear in Creative Tab / JEI](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/22)
 - #23 [[1.20.1] Uncanny Cookies cannot be placed inside Supplementaries Jar](https://github.com/Ax3dGaming/EndersDelight/issues/23)
 - A bug preventing the mod from updating properly

## UPDATED:

 - Many textures to match Farmer's Delight
 - Endstone Stove particle


### Theoretically nothing will break, so feel free to update the mod.

### If you encounter any issues let me know on github
